classification.difficultyReason: Apply the monthly interest and balance calculations repeatedly in a supplied four-month table.

inlines.text: Complete the table for a home loan of $420 000 at a rate of 7.2% p.a. with a monthly repayment of $3306.83. Round each month's interest to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Monthly interest rate: $7.2\%\div12=0.6\%$. Each month's ending balance becomes the next month's starting balance.

Month 1:
$$\begin{aligned}I_1&=420000\times0.006=2520.00\\B_1&=420000+2520.00-3306.83=419213.17\end{aligned}$$
Month 2:
$$\begin{aligned}I_2&=419213.17\times0.006=2515.27902\approx2515.28\\B_2&=419213.17+2515.28-3306.83=418421.62\end{aligned}$$
Month 3:
$$\begin{aligned}I_3&=418421.62\times0.006=2510.52972\approx2510.53\\B_3&=418421.62+2510.53-3306.83=417625.32\end{aligned}$$
Month 4:
$$\begin{aligned}I_4&=417625.32\times0.006=2505.75192\approx2505.75\\B_4&=417625.32+2505.75-3306.83=416824.24\end{aligned}$$
All interest and balance amounts are in dollars.
